title: Bengali Cinema (Tollywood)
summary: Bengali cinema, centred in Kolkata's Tollygunge (hence 'Tollywood'), has a strong tradition from Ray, Ritwik Ghatak and Mrinal Sen to popular commercial films, with Uttam Kumar and Suchitra Sen as classic stars.
